shared_conditions: The general lubricant-change instruction concerns prolonged operation below -15°F (-26°C).
The transmission PMCS fluid claims concern arctic conditions; their temperature thresholds are stated separately.

statements.answer_quote: remove lubricants prescribed for temperatures above -15°F (-26°C) and relubricate with lubricants specified for temperatures below -15°F (-26°C)
statements.statement: For prolonged operation below -15°F (-26°C), remove lubricants prescribed for temperatures above -15°F (-26°C), then relubricate with lubricants specified for temperatures below -15°F (-26°C).

statements.answer_quote: If OEA lubricant is required, it is to be used in place of OE/HDO 10 lubricant for all temperature ranges where OE/HDO 10 is specified
statements.statement: If OEA lubricant is required, use it instead of OE/HDO 10 lubricant throughout all temperature ranges where OE/HDO 10 is specified.

statements.answer_quote: for arctic conditions, OE/HDO 15/40 (Grade 15W-40) lubricant may be used when expected temperatures are above +5°F (-15°C)
statements.statement: In arctic conditions, the transmission PMCS notes say OE/HDO 15/40 (Grade 15W-40) lubricant may be used when expected temperatures are above +5°F (-15°C).

statements.answer_quote: for temperatures below -15°F (-26°C), OEA lubricant is required and must be used in place of OE/HDO 10
statements.statement: In arctic conditions below -15°F (-26°C), the transmission PMCS notes say OEA lubricant is required and must replace OE/HDO 10.
